name: Kirameki School Life SP - The Wonder Years
original_name: きらめきスクールライフSP
source:
This dating sim comes with the limited edition of "Boku wa Tomodachi ga Sukunai Portable". It represents a certain game that appears in the story of the original "Boku wa Tomodachi ga Sukunai" light novels.
